fields.Name: T163 - Studio Ask-Agent Copilot
fields.Description: Exercises the Studio door's docked copilot (onAskAgent starter-prompt path in PSStudioResource) — a different host/entry than the Predictions '+ New prediction' copilot.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Predictive Studio app, open the 'Studio' door on the 'Overview' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Click the 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' hero button (or the 'Ask the agent' entry-path card). Success is a docked co-pilot chat panel opening on the right titled 'Model Dev Agent' with a conversation area seeded/ready for input. You do NOT need to send a message — seeing the docked Model Dev Agent panel open is success. Optionally click its close (X) and verify it dismisses.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' opens a docked chat panel titled 'Model Dev Agent' on the right of the Studio workbench
The panel shows a conversation/message area and can be closed via its X button
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
